2026

Quaternion-Kähler geometry of time reversal symmetric crystals

Hyeongmuk Lim, Junseo Jung, Yuting Qian, Bohm-Jung Yang

arXiv preprint

Identifies quaternion-Kähler quantum geometry for Kramers pairs, extending ideal-band geometric relations to time-reversal-symmetric multiband states. This provides a possible starting point for exploring correlated phases without breaking time reversal.

Real Hopf insulator

Hyeongmuk Lim, Sunje Kim, Bohm-Jung Yang
